description: Gantt Plume turns a task table into a project plan you can read, present and print. Drop Task, Start and End (or Duration), add Groups for a collapsible portfolio › project › phase hierarchy, then Progress and Owner. Free features, no watermark Hierarchy: up to 6 collapsible levels, summary bars and duration-weighted progress. Task grid: owner, dates, duration, progress, outline numbers (1.2.1) and up to 8 of your columns; draggable splitter; Task column width of your choice, long names wrapped. Timeline: zoom from hours to years with the toolbar or Ctrl + mouse wheel; ISO or US weeks, fiscal year, labels such as Q1 FY27, 12- or 24-hour clock. Calendar: business days, weekends and holidays; a today line or a fixed status date; open on today, the start, the end or a chosen date. Milestones in 4 shapes and several bars on one row (absences, machines, split tasks). Sort and label: by start, end, name or your own Sort order field, with a separate order for groups; bar labels from any field; colors by field, group or owner. Interact: search, cross-filtering, right-click menu, tooltips, keyboard, screen readers, high contrast; thousands of tasks with virtual scrolling. Dynamic formatting: drive any Format pane setting with a DAX measure. Premium features ★ Dependencies in Microsoft Project format (3;5SS+2;8FF-1d), with left-to-right arrows, conflicts flagged and the whole chain…
